normalized.result: Yes, that feels clear. Choosing Archive in the side navigation showed me the archived bookmark on its own, and pressing Restore moved it back into All bookmarks with both counts updating to match. Having Restore as a prominent action in the Archive view makes sense, since getting something back is the main reason I'd go there. That completes the reversible side of archiving nicely for me. Happy with it.
